integrity: The theorem and proof are self-contained; analytical area evaluation, normalization, and transition coefficient were checked against independent numerical quadrature and chord sampling. No independent audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to all nondegenerate Euclidean rectangles, not to arbitrary convex polygons; general polygonal bow geometry and contact threshold were known. Novelty conditional on accessible literature comparisons.
title: Exact area profile and cusp transition for maximally inaccessible points of rectangles
